sources.title: Claude Mythos 5 - Claude Platform Docs
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened October 27. Exact claude-mythos-5 entry retains the June 9, 2026 release, verification-required active service, 1M-token context, always-on adaptive thinking, and text/image input to text output. Its current comparison table covers context, output, pricing, thinking, effort, and cutoff; neither nominal total nor active parameters is a column or specification. Documentation inspection, not an endpoint execution test.

sources.title: Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened October 27. June 9 launch explicitly identifies Mythos 5 and Fable 5 as the same underlying model with different safeguards. Calls Mythos 5 an upgrade to Mythos Preview without a sized named-base specification. The benchmark table and launch text disclose no total or active parameter count. Initial Glasswing access, later suspension, and redeployment do not establish size.

sources.title: System Card: Claude Fable 5 & Claude Mythos 5
sources.evidence: October 27 official 319-page PDF retrieval independently searched in full for parameter, numeric B/T/billion/trillion, model-size, active/activated, and lineage terms. Page 11 explicitly gives Fable 5 and Mythos 5 the same underlying weights, with generic pretraining and post-training details but no count. Pages 230-232 discuss an unnamed base snapshot, supplying no sized lineage. Pages 252-253 compare capabilities without parameter columns. Page 13 PEFT is a safeguard method, not a published size; the $100B string on page 279 is a cited article title, not model parameters. Pages 177 and 192 discuss residual-stream steering; no production count or explicit topology label located.

Page 167 Table 8.1.A explicitly compares Fable 5/Mythos 5 with the later models but reports benchmark scores only; no total or activated-parameter column. No Mythos 5 count located.

patch.notes: Mythos 5 and Fable 5 explicitly share underlying model weights. Anthropic does not disclose a nominal total or active parameter count in the reviewed model documentation and system cards.

summary: Fresh parameter-only re-audit on October 27 reopened the exact-model launch, specifications, alignment research, original 319-page card, later 5.1 card, and all three 5.5 cards. Focused first-party searches for total/active counts and sized lineage also led to the official Anthropic model table and exact AWS card. No published nominal total, active count, or sized named base was located: both parameter fields remain explicitly null/undisclosed. The documented Fable 5 shared-weight relationship is valid but supplies no numeric count. Later comparison tables report capabilities without activated-parameter columns. Existing non-parameter assessments are preserved; no endpoint execution test was performed.
